text:
harry: quick flag. onboarding sample 'quickstart-forms' failed for a customer after they upgraded SDK. seems related to JSON mode + function/tool calling.

mina: what broke? any stack or short repro?

harry: behavior is odd: helper that builds tool arguments will pad missing enum fields with empty string during an auth retry. server expects enum or absent; empty string fails validation.

mina: empty string? that's new. send a tiny snippet and logs?

harry: here's a minimal repro i used locally:
```js
// using node SDK v1.5.0-beta
client.callTool('submit_form', {type: 'basic'})
// auth fails -> refresh -> retry
// server received body: {type: 'basic', urgency: ''}
```
urgency is optional enum: 'low'|'normal'|'high' or absent. empty string fails.

dev-bot: CI alert: samples/quickstart-forms e2e — 1 failing test (toolcall-empty-enum.test.js)

mina: ah, this smells like the SDK helper that merges default values for telemetry being too eager during the retry queueing. We set default `''` for some legacy fields.

harry: yes, i traced it: auth wrapper saves a shallow-cloned payload then later merges telemetry defaults for queued items. when the queued copy is materialized for retry it includes defaults. first attempt doesn't have defaults because defaults are injected only on successful send path.

sdk-team: assigning to sdk-team. suggested fix: avoid merging defaults into queued retry payloads; preserve original sparse shape. use a sentinel for "unset" values so we can distinct between explicit empty string vs absent.

mina: sentinel pattern worked in other fixes. can we add a unit test exercising enum vs empty-string vs absent, across node+py sdks? Also check TS typing helpers to ensure optional keys remain optional in generated types.

harry: added a small shim locally: const UNSET = Symbol('UNSET') and when serializing we filter keys where value === UNSET. Retry queue stores UNSET for missing meta but never materializes as ''. fixes sample.

qa: please also add e2e that simulates auth refresh mid-request (token endpoint short-circuit) and verifies server sees no extra keys. CI should catch regressions in samples.

sdk-team: will PR. include changelog: "fix(sdk): preserve absent enum fields on auth/retry in json-mode toolcalls (avoid injecting empty-string defaults)". Backport plan: 1.5.x if approved.

mina: another gotcha: some internal helper used `Object.assign({}, defaults, args)` which will overwrite absent keys with defaults. change to `Object.keys(defaults).forEach(k => args.hasOwnProperty(k) || (args[k] = defaults[k]))` only at final send-time, not for queued payloads.

harry: i put up PR #4444 with tests, e2e, and a tiny migration note for sample authors.

dev-bot: linked issue #6825 created: "sdk: retry injects empty string for optional enum fields in json-mode"

qa: running canary on dedicated env now; will report flakiness if any.

sdk-team: ack — include streaming + SSE transport checks. also audit other defaults injection paths in telemetry and analytics helpers.

harry: thanks all. dropping a small repro script in the PR comments that toggles token endpoint to force refresh. happy to help with testing on customer infra.
